A is the correct distribution. Kathy takes the condominium by survivorship under the tenancy-by-the-entirety deed, a completed lifetime transfer that the prenuptial waiver does not undo, so Julie’s devise is adeemed. Florida law lets a valid prenup waive pretermitted-spouse, elective-share, and similar marital claims, so Tommy takes the pasture under the will and Tommy and Julie split the residue.

CONFIDENCE: 88
